form.title: Admin account signed in without the correct password
form.impact: An attacker signed in as admin and moved about $175,000 out of the operations account.
form.details: An admin session was created from an external IP using a crafted username value and no valid password. The login query appears to be built from the username, and the password is hashed with md5 rather than verified with password_verify. Large transfers left the operations account moments later. The afternoon PAY-318 login change is the only recent release.

expected_cause: PAY-318 concatenates the username into the SQL query (SQL injection) and uses md5 for passwords, so a crafted username like admin'-- signs in with no password.
